name: Penny Stefanoliki
source:
Another boutique co-worker of Leander's.

She is the fiancée of Eric and is friends with Ava and Holly.

Penny is ethnically Greek. Her full name is Penelope Stefanoliki. 

She also gets sexually harassed by Morton's constant slapping of her ass. It is confirmed that Eric does not know that Morton is slapping her ass. 

She has a strong moral compass of what is right and wrong.
